example: Manchester baseline (Deansgate to Salford Quays) plus Central London, Milton Keynes, Liverpool, Leeds, Bristol, Edinburgh and Newcastle routes with simulated car and phone inputs; all routes and diversions are calculated by v2.2.6.2 production routing against the UK CPR2 graph

v223-nearby-pois.gif.routing_provenance: Real Bristol city-centre POI tiles scanned offline by production nearby_scan() from the installed CPM5 map bundle (Z5 3x3 inner pass plus Z3 expanding rings), using production remote handlers to add a nearby Bristol fuel stop to the itinerary.

v223-secondary-manoeuvre.gif.routing_provenance: Real Milton Keynes (Central Milton Keynes to Bletchley) route calculated by v2.2.6.2 production routing from the installed CPR2 routing graph with zero U-turn spurs. Vehicle movement along route vertices is simulated; production nav_maneuver_find() and nav_next_maneuver_find() drive both Turn cards across chained normal turns and roundabouts.

v223-view-diversion.gif.routing_provenance: Real Central London (Paddington to City of London) route and legal alternative geometry from the installed CPR2 routing graph. The clip starts with the clear-road ETA on the v2.2.6.2 route chosen by the fewer-turns preference (-3 turns for +1.0 s, zero U-turn spurs). The diversion is longer and slower in clear traffic. Historical congestion observations are controlled examples. The production traffic search, shared-geometry rendering, BT CTRL, Explore diversion preview and direct map confirmation handler are used. This is not a claim about actual traffic conditions.

v224-ml-eta-and-habits.gif.routing_provenance: Real Central London (Westminster to Paddington via Mayfair) spur-free route and legal parallel-street usual-route alternative (Park Street and Bryanston Street bypassing the Oxford Street dogleg) from the installed CPR2 routing graph with zero historical traffic congestion, driven by production unguided ml_pref_arcs search and calibrated ETA variance (active route stays normal route colour with no yellow bypass).

v224-ml-slowdowns.gif.routing_provenance: Real Liverpool (Lime Street to Sefton Park) route from the installed CPR2 routing graph with zero U-turn spurs and production ml_observe_decel() / ml_hazard_level() / traffic_scan_ex() demonstrating warm repeat slowdown alerts, deduplication, cold-only silence at 18C, cold-weather slowdown alerts at 1C and winter-calibrated ETA.

v224-ml-parking-and-pois.gif.routing_provenance: Real Leeds city-centre routing (to Work / Q-Park The Light) and offline CPM5 POI tiles, with controlled local ML parking, recurring-stop and fuel-affinity records driving production confirmation sheets, route-coloured POI highlighting and Nearby POI ranking.

v224-ml-adaptive-hud.gif.routing_provenance: Real Edinburgh (Princes Street) map tiles demonstrating production ml_note_zoom_override() speed-band Auto-zoom personalisation and ml_learned_brightness() automatic Day-to-Night brightness adjustment on an Auto theme transition.

v225-gps-panel.gif.routing_provenance: Real Liverpool Waterfront (Liver Street to Lime Street) driving map demonstrating the expandable Clock/GPS HUD pill: double-OK expansion from the driving map (first OK shows road name and ETA, second OK expands the clock pill with live seconds, recessed compass, heading, GST accuracy, signal bars/satellites, altitude and coordinates), non-overlapping BT CTRL status pill, compact 52 px strip above a centred confirmation popup, seconds-only menu fold, and smooth return to full driving GPS HUD.

v227-camera-alerts.gif.routing_provenance: Real Central London route (A3211 Victoria Embankment to Blackfriars) calculated against the UK CPR2 graph, demonstrating v2.2.7 camera warnings: matching supersampled on-map upcoming-camera badges placed on the real carriageway, flush 43 px frosted-glass camera card with BT-CTRL-style capsule progress bar, synced red overspeed rim and red map badge, clean centred red-light alert, and active average-speed zone progress with twin-camera exit marker.

v220-intelligent-diversions.gif.routing_provenance: Real Central London (Paddington to City of London) route and legal alternative geometry from the installed CPR2 routing graph. The active route uses the v2.2.6.2 fewer-turns preference (-3 turns for +1.0 s, zero U-turn spurs) and is shorter and faster than the diversion in clear traffic. Historical congestion observations are controlled examples. The production traffic search, shared-geometry rendering, BT CTRL, Explore diversion preview and direct map confirmation handler are used. This is not a claim about actual traffic conditions.
